translations.web: I will cast you out with your mother who bore you into another country, where you were not born; and there you will die.
translations.bsb: I will hurl you and the mother who gave you birth into another land, where neither of you were born—and there you both will die.
translations.kjv: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
translations.asv: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
